            });
        }
}

function get_property_id(a)
{
    var baseurl=$('#baseurl').val();
        if(a!="")
        {
            $.ajax({
                url: baseurl+"Compare/get_property_id",
                type:"post",
                data:{"id":a},
                success: function(data) 
                {
                    simpleNotify.notify('Great ! The property is added to compare list successfully.', 'good');
                }
            });
        }
}

function get_property_id(a)
{
    var baseurl=$('#baseurl').val();
        if(a!="")
        {
            $.ajax({
                url: baseurl+"Compare/get_property_id",
                type:"post",
                data:{"id":a},
                success: function(data) 
                {
                    simpleNotify.notify('Great ! The property is added to compare list successfully.', 'good');
                }
            });
        }
}

Highcharts.chart('container', {
    data: {
        table: 'freq',
        startRow: 1,
        endRow: 17,
        endColumn: 7
    },
    credits: {
            enabled: false
        },

    chart: {
        polar: true,
        type: 'column'
    },

    title: {
        text: 'Global Reach, Local Presence !'
    },

    subtitle: {
        text: 'Property Categories Vs District'
    },

    pane: {
        size: '92%'
    },

    legend: {
        align: 'right',
        verticalAlign: 'top',
        y: 100,
        layout: 'vertical'
    },

    xAxis: {
        tickmarkPlacement: 'on'
    },

    yAxis: {
        min: 0,
        endOnTick: false,
        showLastLabel: true,
        title: {
            text: ''
        },
        labels: {
            formatter: function () {
                return this.value + '%';
            }
        },
        reversedStacks: false
    },

    tooltip: {
        valueSuffix: '%'
    },

    plotOptions: {
        series: {
            stacking: 'normal',
            shadow: false,
            groupPadding: 0,
            pointPlacement: 'on'
        }
    }
});
</script>
